obligations.description: Bring up the isolated staging gateway, validate its production-fingerprint guard against a real staging bot token, start and stop the gateway, and verify lease cleanup.
required_inputs: OpenClaw source tree with scripts/vasily available in the allocated yard
generated staging environment and a staging-only Telegram bot token
authorized exclusive-key consent for the staging zone

obligations.description: Deploy the QA credential broker, seed a staging bot pool, exercise distinct concurrent leases and exhaustion, then release leases and stop the broker.
required_inputs: yard Docker image and network access for Convex and Node deployment images
generated maintainer and CI Convex secrets
synthetic or dedicated staging Telegram bot credentials and group identifiers
